summary: SkyAI, Inc. (Nasdaq: SKYA), formerly Sharps Technology, filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026 disclosing a press release announcing that its previously announced tender offer will launch on October 15, 2026. The offer targets the Company's shares, cash pre-funded warrants, cryptocurrency pre-funded warrants and strategic advisor warrants. No price per share, premium, stake percentage or advisor were disclosed. The offer is self-tender by the issuer, made under Schedule TO and subject to its terms and conditions, and may not commence. The structural overhang from multiple instrument classes and the nascent stablecoin/AI business make terms and funding the key risk-arb variables.
